title: Trip to Lambertville
author: Steve Zakon-Anderson
problems: Row 5 "neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 7 "partners swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 8 "right left through" can't start from where the dancers are: A right and left through needs two dancers on each side.
Row 9 "robins chain" can't start from where the dancers are: The robins must start on opposite sides of the set.
The progression after row 9 "robins chain" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 2 have not passed each other yet.
Row 1 "robins dance in to a long wave in the center - balance the wave" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 1 is not on a side line to dance in.
Row 2 "robins dance out while larks dance in to a long wave in the center - balance the wave" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 is not on a side line to dance in.
